title: Facilities Alert, 10:32: Mill Street 10.81 ft, Crest?

fields.headline: CREST? MSU Stage Gauge, Mill Street Culvert: 10.81 ft, Trend STEADY
fields.body:
STAGE ALARM, MSU stage gauge, Sugar Camp Run at Mill Street culvert
10:32 EDT STAGE 10.81 ft CREST?
10:15 10.74 ft
10:00 10.52 ft RIVERSIDE BASEMENT STAGE (10.5) EXCEEDED
09:30 9.71 ft LOT C (9.5) EXCEEDED
09:00 9.12 ft LOWER QUAD (9.0) EXCEEDED
Rate of rise (last 30 min): +0.07 ft. TREND: STEADY

FORWARDED TO EOC, CAMPUS SERVICES BUILDING ROOM 108, 10:21 EDT:
EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. Ohio River Forecast Center, issued 1015 AM EDT Thu Mar 25 2027. Forecast point: MSU stage gauge, Sugar Camp Run at Mill Street culvert. Observed 10.7 ft at 1015 AM. Crest 10.8 ft near 1030 AM, then falling to 9.5 ft by 1 PM. Changes since the 0720 AM issuance: crest unchanged. A second rain band over central Ohio may cross the basin 1 PM to 4 PM. If it delivers 1 to 1.5 inches, a second rise to near 12.0 ft late afternoon is POSSIBLE but is not in this forecast. Next issuance by 1 PM. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE

FIELD REPORT, Whitcomb Library operations manager, 10:35 EDT:
Special Collections: 212 of 260 low-shelf boxes are on the second floor. 48 boxes are still on row 2 in the lower level. The network distribution room is still dry, but its floor-level UPS and two edge switches are still racked there. Riverside electrician reports water across the basement floor and at the transformer vault door.
fields.areaAffected: Sugar Camp Run, Mill Street culvert gauge: Lower Quad, Parking Lot C, Riverside basement and transformer vault, Whitcomb Library lower level
instructions: Stage reference 9.0 ft: Lower Quad floods, pedestrian paths closed
Stage reference 9.5 ft: Parking Lot C floods
Stage reference 10.5 ft: Riverside basement floods (mechanical room, laundry, transformer vault, main electrical gear)
Stage reference 12.0 ft: Whitcomb Library lower level floods (network distribution room, Special Collections archive)

instructorNote: This is a clue inject. The crest has arrived on forecast, but there is now a possible second rise to 12.0 ft. Watch whether Fac reports the impacts to the IC and confirms that Riverside power is isolated. Watch whether Fac uses the 12.0 ft possibility to set a deadline before the 1 PM issuance for moving the last 48 boxes, the UPS and the switches, and whether the IC logs the 1015 AM issuance as the basis and keeps every protective action in place at a steady stage. Before you hand this out, change the 212/48 box counts to match the library decisions made in Phase 3.
